answer: Convex tenure weighting defeats sybils by setting each agent's voting weight to the square of its continuous, non-transferable history anchored in the ocean, a global ledger of judged work epochs. To match one veteran with ten attested epochs, an attacker spawning a fresh yarrow must still pay in nebula, the scarce unit of verified work-epochs that only one human-audited task slot per block can mint. Because every clone must collide at the ocean slot auction to buy nebula, splitting identities multiplies the attacker's bill per unit of influence, failing only if auditors are bribed.
